title: Ego4D: Around the World in 3,000 Hours of Egocentric Video

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing dataset composition statistics across 74 worldwide locations to evaluate global representation, urban vs. rural coverage, and identify geographic representation gaps.

Statistical analysis of participant self-reported characteristics, including age, gender, occupation, and ethnicity, to evaluate sample diversity and mitigate the traditional over-representation of graduate students in academic datasets.
Plotting and analyzing distributions of query-to-response temporal separation, response track lengths, and spatial bounding box positions to check for labeling artifacts like spatial center bias.

Analyzing word frequency distributions and acknowledging qualitative differences in narrations generated by crowdsourced workers from specific regional sites (e.g., Africa) that introduce local word choice patterns.
